name: Disable 6to4 Tunnel Adapter
description: Disables the legacy 6to4 IPv6 transition mechanism to simplify your Windows TCP/IP stack and reduce unnecessary network overhead.

description_i18n.en: Disables the legacy 6to4 IPv6 transition mechanism to simplify your Windows TCP/IP stack and reduce unnecessary network overhead.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert den veralteten 6to4-IPv6-Übergangsmechanismus, um Ihren Windows-TCP/IP-Stack zu vereinfachen und unnötigen Netzwerkübertragungen vorzubeugen.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive le mécanisme de transition IPv6 6to4 obsolète pour simplifier la pile TCP/IP de Windows et réduire les surcharges réseau inutiles.

warnings.title: Administrator
warnings.message: This tweak to execute. It modifies network stack settings which may affect legacy IPv6 connectivity on specific enterprise environments

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: The script uses PowerShell cmdlets or netsh commands to detect and modify the state of the 6to4 tunnel adapter It can disable this legacy IPv6-over-IPv4 transition mechanism, restore it to default, or check its current status
